title: Effective Cartier closed subscheme of a scheme
statement: Let $X,D$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $i:D\to X$ a morphism. It is an effective Cartier centre if it identifies $D$ with a closed subscheme of $X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose quasi-coherent ideal sheaf is invertible [def-nagata-invertible-ideal], equivalently a closed subscheme whose ideal is locally generated by one non-zero-divisor [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal]. The empty divisor is allowed. This is the general scheme notion, without any curve hypothesis.
